name: huashu-motion
cost: Free (MIT). The music is made on your machine with no paid API
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Grok Bot, Muse, Dots and other agents that support Agent Skills
short: An agent skill that makes a product launch film with its own music, then lets you click a frame to change just that part.
what: You ask your agent for something like a 30 second launch film. It reads your product, offers three directions, writes the film as a web page drawn with code, writes a score and plays it with instrument samples, then opens an editor in your browser. You press C, click a spot in the frame and write what to change, and the agent changes only that spot. It exports MP4, transparent MOV, WebM or GIF.
who: Makers who want a short launch or explainer video without a video editor, and who are fine running commands locally. The README is in Chinese, with an English version linked at the top. It has only been tested on macOS, so Windows and Linux users may hit rough edges.
needs: Chrome, Chromium or Edge already installed
FFmpeg, for exporting video and mixing the music
Optional: about 55MB of free instrument samples (`om samples build`), and uv with Python 3.12 for Chinese voiceover with Kokoro

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.text: The skills CLI detects your agent. Add `-a claude-code` or `-a codex` to pick one.

steps.title: Check what is missing
steps.text: Run `om doctor` to see which tools are missing. The README says your agent can install them for you.

steps.title: Ask for a film
steps.text: Describe the product and length. The agent shows keyframes for three directions, then builds the one you pick and opens the editor.

steps.title: Point at what to change
steps.text: In the editor, press C, click the frame and type your note. Titles, numbers, colours and timings also show up as fields you can edit yourself. Every version is kept, and ⌘Z undoes.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Use huashu-motion to make a 30 second launch film for my product. The website is xxx.com." (translated from the README's Chinese example)

watch: It has only been tested on macOS.
Films of 4 seconds or longer get a small "Made with huashu-motion" line in the last 1.2 seconds. Ask your agent to turn it off if you don't want it.
The optional samples and the Kokoro voice model are downloads (about 55MB and about 325MB).
Codex's sandbox blocks the local preview and the browser, so you will need to approve those by hand.
The author says the agent cannot hear. It checks the music from the score and charts, so listen to it yourself before you publish.
The 豆子花叔 cartoon character in the repo is not covered by the MIT licence.
